scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sijaf/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @sijaf/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @sijaf/api" "npm run dev -w @sijaf/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sijaf/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sijaf/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
